AI-assisted review:

> Non-blocking follow-up: could we add coverage for `s.n::VARCHAR` where the schema declares `n` as STRUCT with explicit `children`, but the file stores it as VARCHAR? The [leaf conversion guard](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/1d667dcb2fcd08c70827b555ee10840c1db55339/src/common/multi_file/multi_file_column_mapper.cpp#L747) only checks fields without children, so by inspection this looks like it can return the original text without validating the declared STRUCT type. This appears pre-existing and is fine to address separately.
